description: React component for the MembershipsPage, managing subscription plans, user membership state, and displaying perks.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads membership plans, current membership, activity status, and perks asynchronously.

methods.name: onSubscribe
methods.description: Handles subscribing to a plan, updates current membership, and shows notification.

methods.name: onCancel
methods.description: Cancels current membership and updates state with notification.
